posts.content: Follow the LOL-FUHSI 😂🎥🧬 channel on WhatsApp: https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbD2kchAjPXMnTxXc52E

Good morning from FUHSI 
E no easy, but we move! 💪
 This school go make me who I wan be.

FUHSI, my school, my pride 🎓

FUHSI, Ila-Orangun



WELCOME TO FUHSI, FRESHERS! ❤️🎓

Welcome to Federal University of Health Sciences, Ila-Orangun!

My fellow freshers, I want to welcome you specially. You don enter a new chapter of your life.

Make I tell una truth — e no go easy always.

For FUHSI, you go read tire. Lecture go long. Practical go stress you. Sometimes you go miss house food. Sometimes you go feel like "why I choose this course?" 😭

But make I tell you something: You no come here by mistake.

Out of thousands of people wey apply, na you dem pick. Na you God choose to be here. Na you go wear white coat one day. Na you go save life one day.

So my advice for you as fresher:

1. No compare yourself with anybody. Everybody get their own speed. Your own time go come.

2. Find good friends.For FUHSI, friends fit make you or break you. Find friends wey go push you to read, not friends wey go push you to party every day.

3. Respect your lecturers, but no fear them.Ask question. Na question dey make you sabi.

4. Take care of your health.You dey study health, but no forget your own health. Sleep small, chop well, drink water.

5. No give up. If you fail one test, e no mean you be failure. E mean say you need to try another way.
Ila-Orangun go teach you patience. FUHSI go teach you strength. And one day, when you graduate, you go look back and say "Thank God I no give up."

Welcome to FUHSI once again!

FUHSI TO THE WORLD! 🎓❤️

Drop your course for comment — make we know our new fresher

A special shout-out to our amazing STAYLITES! 💚🤍 Thank you for keeping the FUHSI spirit alive. Let's welcome our freshers warmly, guide them, support them and make them feel at home. Together, we make FUHSI stronger! 🎓🔥

🎓 WELCOME TO FUHSI — THE JOURNEY BEGINS! 🩺✨

To all newly admitted students and incoming freshers of the Federal University of Health Sciences, Ila-Orangun (FUHSI), welcome to a new chapter of growth, learning, discovery and endless possibilities.

We're not just coming to school; we're becoming part of a community built on knowledge, excellence, ambition and purpose.

As a fellow fresher, I'm excited to be part of this journey with you all. Let's connect, support one another, make meaningful memories and build a community worth belonging to.

One campus. One community. One vision. One FUHSI! 💚🤍

#FUHSI #FUHSIFreshers #FUHSI2026 #FutureHealthProfessionals
